coordinateSummary.warning: All newly created positions are development-stage corridor reconciliations. They must be replaced with exact authoritative stop coordinates without changing composite IDs.

topologyDecisions: Lines 030 and 031 are each stored as two independently ordered open patterns.
All four patterns use closesLoop false; no reverse sequence or last-to-first edge is inferred.
The operator classifies both lines as special panoramic double-decker services, but that fare/service classification does not convert either route into a closed graph cycle.
Line 030 reuses the established Benidorm–Finestrat–La Vila western corridor identities.
Line 031 reuses the established Benidorm–L’Alfàs–Altea eastern corridor identities and adds only previously unseen operator codes.
Shared terminals may end one direction and begin another without converting the pair into a closed cycle.
identityDecisions: All accepted shared StopNodes and StopPlaces are copied exactly from prior Benidorm scenarios.
BND 257 remains distinct from nearby BND 345, BND 208 and BND 364 because its operator code is different.
ALT 451 is reused as the Line 031 Altea terminal in both directions without closing the route cycle.
ALT 417, ALT 418 and ALT 419 remain separate port/coastal directional identities.
Every new StopNode receives a singleton StopPlace; proximity and matching corridor descriptions do not merge identities.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty for new nodes because no individual OSM platform or stop_position object was adopted as strict runtime evidence.

reviewItems.detail: Replace all 10 newly created development positions with exact authoritative coordinates while preserving composite IDs and cross-package exact equality.
The current route page was cross-checked against a complete 2025 official print sequence. Recheck for route drift if a newer complete printable capture becomes available.
The operator identifies Lines 030 and 031 as special panoramic services. Operating-calendar/fare eligibility remains provenance and is not encoded as route graph topology.
